where: crates/blaze-kernel/src/session.rs Session::post, Session::seed_valued, Changed::valued; lib.rs find_key
what: A carried session needed an exact difference for every kind of read, and no maintainer gives one (31 fact kinds, deltas that hold one write, a changed set that leaves out released memos), so every kind a body read was said `everything` and every entry was looked up again from its read list at each revision. The session knew every read an entry made but not what it saw: `Session::post` took names only, though the walk and the trace had each value in hand.
cost: a revision re-verified every body entry of a crate (microseconds an entry) where the carry reached a handful
cause: the index kept who read what but threw away what was read, so the only exact difference had to come from outside the kernel
class: a dependency index that records edges without the value each edge observed, which forces every invalidation to trust an external producer
prevention: a posting keeps what its read saw (layout 3); `Changed::valued(kind)` values each distinct posted read once and seeds only the readers of those that differ, so no kind is ever always dirty; the exhaustive check runs under all three ways of saying a difference with four planted bugs (ValuedGoneSame, ValuedUnloaded, SeenAtFirstPost, KindSaidClean)
